issue.title: Home-mode running marker updates the artifact index five times instead of four
issue.description: Full ToolRun d02484c8a231414af73aa4fd8fe21a9a failed after 56,385 passed and 17 skipped with this node as the only failure; isolated ToolRun 43e115ad45e4760cce9025f6b0342921 reproduced it. The assertion in tests/test_axe_run_agent_runner_started_at.py expects setup_index_update.call_count == 4, but observes 5 during successful home-mode marker cleanup. Determine whether the extra setup update is intended or a runner setup regression, then correct the implementation or expectation.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The node failed in the full just check lane and failed again in an isolated just test run on the same source tree, with the same call count mismatch of five versus four. The implementation diff changes only SIGTERM handling and process termination, not the successful home-mode marker setup call path.

issue.creation_reason: The full check lane and an isolated rerun both fail the same marker-index test on the same source tree. The changed SIGTERM paths do not call the setup index updater, so this separate confirmed CI failure needs an owner.

payload.description: Verify the confirmed CI failure record before finalizing check results

payload.entry: Landing triage of proposing bead sase-1lh.7.5.4.3.3.1 note #1: ToolRun 8775b093bf0c40e4efc3dc60e050f7f2 reports the same home-mode setup_index_update count 5 vs 4. Exact existing owner; no duplicate task. This local-only node is outside the release repair unless it becomes a CI gate.

evidence.note: Independent rescue-refactor verification reproduced the exact node in both check ToolRuns 8e9cc3933691a10bfbce4fe4750d917d and 5dda94530f24f5a713bd26cbf105a250, and in targeted ToolRun 2a444876749d618a17d88ee82315d147. It continues to observe setup_index_update.call_count == 5 instead of 4 on unchanged runner code; no rescue files are involved.
